from itertools import permutations

def find_all_interval_series(n=6):
    for perm in permutations(range(n)):
        diffs = [abs(perm[i+1] - perm[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
        if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n)):
            return perm, diffs
    return None, None

solution, diffs = find_all_interval_series()
print(f"Solution: {list(solution)}")
print(f"Differences: {diffs}")
print(f"Values are permutation of 0-5: {sorted(solution) == list(range(6))}")
print(f"Diffs are permutation of 1-5: {sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, 6))}")

sol = [0, 5, 1, 4, 2, 3]
print("Series:", sol)
print("\nStep-by-step verification:")
for i in range(len(sol)-1):
    d = abs(sol[i+1] - sol[i])
    print(f"  |{sol[i+1]} - {sol[i]}| = {d}")
diffs = [abs(sol[i+1] - sol[i]) for i in range(len(sol)-1)]
print(f"\nAll values (0–5): {sorted(sol)}")
print(f"All differences (1–5): {sorted(diffs)}")
